title: Posters and signs with words, for your room

comfyui.note: Uses only built-in ComfyUI nodes (plus the custom node listed, if any). Update ComfyUI if a node shows red.

inputs.default: retro poster art, steaming ramen bowl, neon city night, bold graphic shapes, large blank space at the top for a title

settings: 704x1408, 28 steps, CFG 6, Real-ESRGAN to 1024x2048. SDXL can't write: add the words yourself.
forWhat: Wall posters, shop signs, menu boards and banners with readable words.
output: 1024x2048 PNG (portrait poster). Power-of-two, so it works as a texture.
vtp: Put it on a poster or sign in your room (Blender), or use it as the in-room screen picture.
ask: Set up the VTube Pro poster workflow in ComfyUI
steps: Write the words in quotes inside "Your prompt", like the title "LATE NIGHT RAMEN".
Press Run. Small: add the words in any editor afterwards.
tips: No real brands or logos: make your own designs.
Short titles come out best (2-4 words).
licenceSummary: Commercial use OK by default: CreativeML Open RAIL++-M, BSD-3-Clause.
